falsifierResults.falsifier3_soleEmitterConfirmed: Re-confirmed after the edit: pipeline_output_absent and the HollowXrayRefuse/formatHollowXrayRefuse shape exist ONLY in src/xray-export-gate.ts, consumed at exactly 2 call sites in src/tools.ts (refuseHollowXrayResult in refresh_parcel_dossier_export; isStoredDossierArtifactHollow+formatStoredHollowRefuse in download_parcel_dossier_export, both leading to formatHollowXrayRefuse/formatStoredHollowRefuse). dossier-export-contract.ts only declares the verdictIncluded/briefFactCount TYPE fields the gate reads; it does not itself emit an error.
